flashlight.blocker: Only the exact recorded nominal digital subsets are admitted; full 16-code guest/PWM/dynamic-S1/physical equivalence remain open. Partial nominal digital model: only qualified GPIO bitbang HI/LO 750..10000ns and steady Torch. Last-rise+500us latch and first-rise+nominal deadline are explicit model policies. No LEDC waveform, EN PWM, dynamic S1, analog/electrical/optical/current/thermal or bit-exact equivalence. Historical 0045-only runtime had unlatched route history; 0046/3f1617 records scoped route-history acceptance, and 0047/e318 now verify the cold constructor low baseline plus original API on four S3 hosts. model_policies.latch: last observed rising edge + 500000ns stable high
model_policies.torch: steady EN high, no Flash deadline; EN PWM unqualified
model_policies.mode_selection: creation-only synthetic fixture; default Flash; frozen after all initial values
model_policies.cold_start: 0047/e318 verifies that the original constructor's low write establishes a trusted low baseline without a prior high edge. The host waits for output-known/pad-synchronized instead of inferring from a low pad read.
model_policies.route_history: Historical 0045-only/7c898 getter suppression did not latch route loss. In scoped 0046/3f1617 acceptance, actual OUT_SEL changes withdraw internal qualification, all three timers and prior low intervals; returning to GPIO does not restore old output. Recovery requires a fresh observed supported GPIO falling edge and complete long-low reset, then a new program. Route events do not add pad edges/decoded counts. UNIT-HOST-38 is fixed for the recorded OUT_SEL path; UNIT-HOST-37 cold constructor is fixed separately by 0047/e318; full OEN/IOMUX/PWM and real-time Web remain open.
